headline: AI's Hidden Cost: The Multi-Billion Dollar Energy Gold Rush
reasoning: This topic scores highly on mainstream appeal and clickability by revealing a surprising, tangible consequence of the AI boom: a massive strain on the power grid. It translates the abstract world of AI into a physical-world problem of energy and money, making it highly relatable for a general audience. While not a direct 'how-to', it offers significant contextual value and can be adapted into various engaging formats like explainers or listicles.
summary: The massive energy demands of AI data centers are creating a bottleneck, causing investors to pour billions into energy companies. This has sparked a surge in IPOs for firms specializing in power infrastructure, from nuclear and geothermal to traditional electrical equipment.

source_articles.title: Energy IPOs surge as investors hunt for ways to play AI boom
source_articles.excerpt: Companies coming to market are raising money at fastest pace this century.
